text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So there's this girl who just lost a race,
and she's
here at school today...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder, what sort of gesture would
make her
feel better?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. In the language of flowers,
chamomile
symbolizes "energy in
adversity," so...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, I think I'll make some
chamomile tea
for her. I hope it'll help
cheer her up!
